/about.title: About Us
/about.description: Discover Tap & Wrap: thoughtful gifts, personal touches and considered presentation, with a conversation at the heart of every custom request.
/about.heading: About Us
paragraphs: A gift can say what an ordinary moment cannot.
Made meaningful by you

A name, a favourite photograph, a message only the two of you understand. These are the details that turn an object into something worth keeping. Tap & Wrap brings thoughtful gifting and personal expression together, from choosing a gift to considering how it will be presented.
Your idea, thoughtfully wrapped

Explore the collection for a gift that feels right. Where a product offers Customize This, add the requested photographs, text or choices before adding it to your cart. Product personalization keeps the approved product or selected variant price unchanged.

For something more individual, build a Gift Box and add it to your cart alongside other gifts. Standalone Engraving is work on your own physical item: add the service to the same cart, then arrange inspection with us. New standalone engraving orders include the service price at checkout. Inspection and final design acceptance are required before engraving work. Historical orders retain their original payment terms.
A conversation before the finishing touches

Clear details matter as much as beautiful presentation. Unconfirmed prices stay unconfirmed, delivery is agreed separately, and custom quotations distinguish the work, add-ons and delivery. After an order or request is submitted, our commitment is initial WhatsApp contact within 12 hours.
Unlock the Magic of Giving. Thoughtful gifts, made personal.

/contact.title: Contact Us
/contact.description: Contact Tap & Wrap on WhatsApp, by email or on Instagram for gifts, personalization, order support and delivery enquiries.
/contact.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: Tell us who it is for. We’ll help with the details.
Start a conversation
WhatsApp is our main channel for gift enquiries, quotations, delivery arrangements and order support. If you already have an order or request, include its reference so we can find the right record.
For submitted orders and custom requests, we make initial contact within 12 hours. This is a contact commitment, not a delivery or final quotation deadline.
Keep payments separate from support

The WhatsApp support number in our footer is for customer support. It is not the InstaPay receiving number. Use the payment instructions saved against your order or accepted quotation, and verify them with us if anything differs.

Please do not send passwords, account recovery links or unrelated financial information. For website orders, use the secure payment-proof action provided for your order; custom quotation evidence can be discussed directly with the owner on WhatsApp.

/shipping-policy.title: Shipping & Delivery
/shipping-policy.description: How Tap & Wrap confirms delivery availability, fees and timing separately from merchandise, with initial WhatsApp contact within 12 hours.
/shipping-policy.heading: Shipping & Delivery
paragraphs: A clear delivery agreement, before the journey begins.
Delivery is Pending Confirmation

Product prices exclude delivery unless an explicitly agreed offer says otherwise. Initial checkout does not collect a final delivery fee: the amount is pending, not EGP 0 or free shipping. Pending add-on quotations are separate from delivery charges.
Initial contact within 12 hours

After you submit an order or custom request, the owner contacts you on WhatsApp within 12 hours to review the details. This does not promise delivery, a final quotation or completion of payment within 12 hours. Please provide an accurate Egyptian WhatsApp number and destination.
Availability, fee and timing

Delivery availability, cost and expected timing depend on the destination, the gift and any personalization or preparation needed. We confirm these details with you rather than promise a fixed delivery time or nationwide coverage. Tell us about an occasion date before agreeing the order so we can discuss feasibility.
Your agreed charges

The owner records the delivery quotation and your acceptance separately from merchandise and add-ons. A later change requires a revised agreement; an unaccepted charge is not an agreed payable balance.

For COD, agreed merchandise and delivery charges may be collected on delivery. For website InstaPay orders, the initial transfer covers the approved items and services in your order; agreed delivery is settled separately by the recorded method. For custom requests, delivery is part of the separately itemised quotation you accept before payment.
Changes and delivery problems

Contact us with your reference if your address or arrangements change, or if delivery is delayed, refused or arrives damaged. We review the circumstances, agreed charges and any legally required remedy. A failed delivery does not automatically remove your rights or determine a refund.

/refund-policy.title: Returns & Refunds
/refund-policy.description: Tap & Wrap returns, cancellation and refund information for ordinary and personalized gifts, preserving mandatory Egyptian consumer protections.
/refund-policy.heading: Returns & Refunds
paragraphs: Personal gifts deserve care. So do your rights.
Your statutory rights

This policy is guided by Egypt’s Consumer Protection Law No. 181 of 2018 and Consumer Protection Agency guidance. Where the statutory conditions apply, ordinary goods can be returned or exchanged within 14 days of receipt without a reason or additional expense. Legal exceptions apply. Defective or nonconforming goods have a 30-day return or exchange protection, without prejudice to other applicable guarantees or more favourable rights.
Personalized and made-to-specification gifts

The change-of-mind exception applies to goods genuinely made to specifications you supplied and matching those specifications, where the law permits. A made-by-request label alone does not remove ordinary consumer rights. Personalization never excludes remedies for a defective, incorrect or nonconforming item.
Changing or cancelling an order

Contact us as soon as possible with your reference. Before production, we review whether the order can be changed or cancelled and reconcile any funds already received. Once production begins, feasibility and any lawful consequences depend on the work actually undertaken and your statutory rights. We explain the position before recording an agreement; production starting is not a blanket refusal of refunds.
Incorrect customization, damage or other faults

Tell us what differs from the agreed specification or what went wrong. Your reference, description and relevant photographs can help us investigate; they do not replace or shorten your legal rights. We arrange the applicable exchange, return, refund or other lawful remedy without imposing an extra charge where the law prohibits one. Contacting us promptly helps, but we do not impose a shorter reporting deadline than the law allows.
Refunds and return arrangements

We explain return arrangements and record the agreed or legally required remedy, including the amount and payment reconciliation. Applicable statutory handling deadlines and payment-method requirements take precedence. An uploaded receipt or cancellation request alone does not mean a refund has been completed. Payment and refund history is retained rather than silently replacing the original transaction.
If you need help

Contact us through the channels on our Contact page. If an issue remains unresolved, you may seek assistance from Egypt’s Consumer Protection Agency. Nothing in these terms prevents a complaint or access to statutory remedies.

/privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy.description: How Tap & Wrap handles contact details, orders, private personalization images, payment evidence, communications, cookies and privacy requests.
/privacy-policy.heading: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Your gift may be personal. Your information should be handled with care.
Information you provide

We process customer and guest names, Egyptian phone numbers, optional email, governorate, city or area, street address, optional building details and delivery notes, order selections and communications needed to handle enquiries and fulfil agreed orders. Accounts also use authentication and recovery information. Gift Box and Engraving requests include your preferences, budget, instructions and optional email; an account or email is not required to submit those requests.
Photographs, artwork and payments

Personalization and request uploads may include photographs, text and artwork. Website InstaPay evidence is uploaded privately against an accepted order in checkout or through its secure order page; custom quotation evidence may be sent to the owner on WhatsApp. We record payment references, reconciled amounts, acceptance and financial history. Do not upload unrelated personal or financial information. Screenshots alone never establish that funds were received.
Why we use it and who can access it

We use the information to review requests, prepare quotations, record acceptance, manage orders and delivery, reconcile payments, support customers, secure accounts and meet applicable obligations. Authorized staff access customer information and private files for these purposes. Public catalog photographs are separate from private customer uploads; private artwork and payment proofs are not public product media.
Services supporting the store

The platform uses Cloudflare Workers and R2 for website delivery and storage, Render for the API and MongoDB Atlas for database processing. Configured email services support transactional communications. WhatsApp and Instagram are external channels with their own privacy terms. Data may be processed outside your location through these services. We do not claim a particular security certification or guarantee.
Communications, cookies and choices

WhatsApp is the primary channel for quotations and delivery discussions; the owner sends messages manually. Email supports order, quotation, status and account-security communications where an appropriate address exists. Necessary session and security cookies support accounts, carts and protected actions. Optional Meta advertising measurement requires consent and separate activation; declining or withdrawing consent must not prevent ordinary ordering. These pages contain no tracking pixels.
Retention and deletion

Temporary uploads, submitted requests, accepted-order attachments and financial records have different retention needs. We do not promise deletion after a fixed period. Order evidence, fraud/security records and financial history may need to be retained for legal, accounting or dispute purposes. A deletion request is reviewed against those obligations; retained evidence is not automatically erased by cancellation.
Your privacy requests

Contact us to ask about access, correction, deletion or other applicable rights, or to raise a privacy concern. We may need proportionate verification of your identity and relationship to an order before disclosing or changing records. Never send a password or recovery link.

/terms-of-service.title: Terms & Conditions
/terms-of-service.description: Tap & Wrap terms for normal purchases, personalization, WhatsApp-first quotations, COD, InstaPay, separate delivery and customer remedies.
/terms-of-service.heading: Terms & Conditions
paragraphs: Know what is agreed, what is pending, and what happens next.
Browsing, prices and availability

Browsing does not guarantee that an item is orderable. Only merchant-approved prices and eligible availability can proceed to checkout. Unpriced or unavailable gifts can be discussed on WhatsApp without becoming a purchase. Prices are in EGP; the server validates the selected variant, quantity, discounts and approved amounts. Availability can change before order creation.
Normal orders and personalization

Review your items and details before submitting. A successfully created order has a unique reference; an order awaiting payment is not a paid order. Where Customize This is required, complete the configured information before adding the product to your cart. Personalization does not change the approved product or selected variant price. Provide accurate instructions and only images or designs you are entitled to use for the requested work.
Bespoke quotation requests

Separate bespoke requests begin without upfront payment or a required account. A known-price estimate is not a final quotation. The owner reviews feasibility and records the product/work amount, add-ons, delivery and available payment methods in a versioned quotation, then shares it manually through WhatsApp.

You accept through WhatsApp and the owner records that acceptance before requesting payment. Changes to an accepted quotation require a new version and renewed acceptance. New bespoke quotations offer both COD and InstaPay without additional payment-method authorization; historical accepted quotations retain their recorded terms. You do not have to revisit the website to complete this quotation workflow.
COD and InstaPay

Cash on Delivery and InstaPay are available for all eligible new website orders, including personalized products, Gift Boxes, standalone engraving and mixed carts. Historical orders and separate bespoke quotations retain their accepted payment terms. For website InstaPay checkout, create the order first, then follow its saved instructions and upload proof securely against that order. The approved receiving number is 01060673073. Verify any differing destination directly with the owner before transferring; the public WhatsApp number is a support channel.

For accepted custom quotations, follow the saved quotation and send the screenshot to the owner on WhatsApp. In both flows the owner independently reconciles the receiving account before marking payment verified. A screenshot, message, email or uploaded file alone is not confirmation of payment. No automatic card payment or deposit is part of this flow.
Separate charges and delivery

Initial normal checkout covers approved merchandise, not a final shipping charge. Delivery starts as Pending Confirmation. The owner makes initial WhatsApp contact within 12 hours; this is not a delivery or final quotation deadline. Unknown add-ons remain separate from delivery and require pricing and customer acceptance before becoming agreed payable amounts. An explicitly Free add-on is different from one awaiting a price.
Fulfilment, changes and remedies

Product images help describe gifts; confirm important material, size, colour, personalization and occasion requirements before agreement. We do not promise unsupported options or an unconfirmed delivery date. Tell us promptly about changes, cancellation, damage or a mismatch. The Returns & Refunds policy applies subject to mandatory Egyptian consumer rights; no term excludes remedies for defective, incorrect or nonconforming goods.
Support, privacy and applicable law

Use the contact channels on our Contact page and include your reference. The Privacy Policy explains customer information and private uploads. These terms are subject to applicable Egyptian law and mandatory consumer protections. Nothing limits access to the Consumer Protection Agency or other competent authorities.
